name: agent-tool-platform
description: Shared runtime, testkit, capability registry, agent composition, and infrastructure primitives for hosted agent tool servers.

scripts.build: npm run build:platform && npm run build:server --workspace @agent-tool-platform/agent-builder && npm run build:client --workspace @agent-tool-platform/agent-builder
scripts.build:platform: npm run deployment:schemas && npm run registry:schemas && npm run registry:generate && npm run build --workspace @agent-tool-platform/runtime --workspace @agent-tool-platform/capability-registry --workspace @agent-tool-platform/agent-kit --workspace @agent-tool-platform/testkit --workspace @agent-tool-platform/example-minimal-capability
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:platform && npm run typecheck --workspace @agent-tool-platform/agent-builder
scripts.test: npm run test:platform && npm run test --workspace @agent-tool-platform/agent-builder
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage:platform && npm run test:coverage --workspace @agent-tool-platform/agent-builder
